children: On September 1, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that its common stock failed to maintain the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days, violating Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). Nasdaq granted a 180-day grace period to regain compliance by achieving a $1.00 bid for at least 10 consecutive business days, with the possibility of a second 180-day period and potential reverse stock split; there is no immediate delisting.
